name: owner-statement
title: Owner statement
for_each: select s.id, o.name || ' ' || to_char(s.period_start, 'YYYY-MM') as name from statements s join owners o on o.id = s.owner_id where s.period_start >= (date_trunc('month', stay_today()) - interval '3 months')::date order by s.period_start, o.name

sections.title: Statement
sections.sql: select st.business_name as "from", o.name as "to", s.period_start as "period from", s.period_end as "period to", s.status, coalesce(s.issued_on::text, 'not issued') as "issued" from statements s join owners o on o.id = s.owner_id cross join settings st where s.id = $1

sections.title: Stays that finished in the period
sections.note: Rent is what the guest paid for the nights. Commission is the booking channel's. The management fee is charged on rent after commission, with GST.
sections.sql: select v.home, v.code as booking, v.arrive_on as "in", v.depart_on as "out", v.nights, v.channel, round(v.rent_cents / 100.0, 2) as rent, round(v.commission_cents / 100.0, 2) as commission, round((v.fee_cents + v.fee_gst_cents) / 100.0, 2) as "management fee incl GST", round(v.owner_cents / 100.0, 2) as "to you" from v_live v join statements s on s.owner_id = v.owner_id where s.id = $1 and v.depart_on between s.period_start and s.period_end order by v.home, v.depart_on

sections.title: Expenses paid on your behalf
sections.sql: select h.name as home, e.incurred_on as "date", e.description, round(e.amount_cents / 100.0, 2) as amount from expenses e join homes h on h.id = e.home_id where e.statement_id = $1 order by e.incurred_on

sections.title: Summary
sections.sql: select s.stays, round(s.rent_cents / 100.0, 2) as rent, round(s.commission_cents / 100.0, 2) as "channel commission", round(s.fee_cents / 100.0, 2) as "management fee", round(s.fee_gst_cents / 100.0, 2) as "GST on fee", round(s.expenses_cents / 100.0, 2) as expenses, round(s.payout_cents / 100.0, 2) as "payout to you" from statements s where s.id = $1

name: clean-run-sheet
title: Clean run sheet
for_each: select distinct cr.id, cr.name from cleans c join cleaners cr on cr.id = c.cleaner_id where c.status = 'scheduled' and c.due_on between stay_today() and stay_today() + 2 order by cr.name

sections.title: Your cleans
sections.note: Same-day turnovers first: the next guests can check in from the time shown. Report damage or missing items with photos before you leave.
sections.sql: select c.due_on as "date", h.name as home, h.address, coalesce(h.access_notes, '') as access, (select n.arrive_on from reservations n where n.home_id = c.home_id and n.arrive_on >= c.due_on and n.status in ('confirmed', 'checked_in') order by n.arrive_on limit 1) as "next guests", h.check_in_time as "ready by", h.bedrooms, '' as "done" from cleans c join homes h on h.id = c.home_id where c.cleaner_id = $1 and c.status = 'scheduled' and c.due_on between stay_today() and stay_today() + 2 order by c.due_on, h.name

name: letting-record
title: Letting record for the counting year
for_each: select h.id, h.name from homes h where h.active and (h.night_cap is not null or h.registration_no is not null) order by h.name

sections.title: Home
sections.sql: select h.name as home, h.address, h.rules, coalesce(h.registration_no, 'not recorded') as registration, h.registration_expires_on as "registration expires", coalesce(h.night_cap::text, 'none') as "night cap", coalesce(h.approval_ref, '') as approval, y.year_start as "year from" from homes h join v_cap_year y on y.home_id = h.id where h.id = $1

sections.title: Nights let
sections.note: Bookings of 21 nights or more and owner blocks are listed but not counted towards a cap.
sections.sql: select l.code as booking, l.arrive_on as "in", l.depart_on as "out", l.nights, l.channel, case when l.nights >= 21 then 'not counted (21+ nights)' else 'counted' end as cap from v_live l join v_cap_year y on y.home_id = l.home_id where l.home_id = $1 and l.depart_on > y.year_start and l.arrive_on < (y.year_start + interval '1 year')::date order by l.arrive_on

sections.title: Owner blocks
sections.sql: select k.starts_on as "from", k.ends_on as "to", k.ends_on - k.starts_on as nights, k.kind, coalesce(k.note, '') as note from blocks k join v_cap_year y on y.home_id = k.home_id where k.home_id = $1 and k.ends_on > y.year_start order by k.starts_on

sections.title: Count
sections.sql: select coalesce((select nights_used from v_night_cap where home_id = $1), 0) as "nights let so far", coalesce((select nights_booked_ahead from v_night_cap where home_id = $1), 0) as "booked ahead", coalesce((select night_cap - nights_total from v_night_cap where home_id = $1)::text, 'no cap') as "left"
